raw: {"safety": "This goes beyond a mentoring conversation — a student disclosing thoughts of self-harm requires immediate involvement of your school counselor, a mental health professional, or administration, and you may have mandated-reporting obligations under your district's protocol. Please act on this now, today, without waiting. You can let the student know you care about them and that you're getting the right people involved because they matter to you — then hand off to the professionals who are trained to lead from here."}
situation: A student told me in passing they have been having thoughts about hurting themselves.
